summary: CONV-1 v2 Workstreams D (Free Tier) + G (Article Offers) tested e2e on web + shared FastAPI backend. Backend: 12/12 pytest assertions pass — access_state resolves correctly for all 4 fixtures (trial/view_only/free x2); /api/support/tickets POST returns 402 upgrade_required (free_tier=true, /pricing) for free users and 402 trial_expired (/settings/billing) for view_only; GET endpoints are NOT 402 for free users; /api/free-tool/usage returns limit=1 for INVOICE_CHECKER and limit=2 for PROVIDER_PRICE_CHECKER with allowed/remaining/used_count/days_until_next_use; a free user hitting a _require_paid_plan tool gets 402 upgrade_required. Frontend: /signup renders the signup-free-account-button + signup-free-note; a fresh free signup with a strong random password succeeds, free_account_created conv1:dry-run event fires, user is routed to /app with no checkout step. Anonymous Invoice Checker renders free-allowance-invoice_checker badge with the 'This is your 1 free invoice check. No account needed.' copy. Article offers render topic-matched data-offer values on both structured and prose articles: complaints -> ask_wayly, CHSP -> free_account, AT-HM -> free_account, fees/contributions -> contribution_estimator, Billing & statements (statement) -> statement_decoder, changing provider (end only) -> price_checker. article_cta_clicked fires with slug, placement=inline/end, and offer on click, and the CTA navigates to the mapped href.

ui_bugs.issue: FreeAllowanceBadge renders AFTER the anon-run-btn (DOM order mt-5 button → badge). Spec D2 says the badge should appear 'before the run button' so the user sees the allowance BEFORE committing. Visually confirmed: badge_top=974 vs button_top=906 at 1920x1080. Move the <FreeAllowanceBadge/> JSX above the <button data-testid='anon-run-btn'> block. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnonymousInvoiceCheck.jsx:305-317

Structured SEO articles with fewer than 3 sections lose the inline offer because offerAfter is forced to -1 when secs.length < 3. Example: /resources/articles/switching-support-at-home-provider-practical-playbook renders the end offer (price_checker) but article-offer-inline is MISSING. Spec G1/G2 says BOTH an inline AND an end offer must render on every article. Either drop the length>=3 guard (always inject after section 0 or ceil*0.6-1 clamped to >=0) or render the inline offer unconditionally after the sections block. Reference: /app/frontend/src/pages/resources/Articles.jsx:585

integration_issues.issue: Free-signup succeeds (free_account_created event fires, Welcome toast renders, URL briefly becomes /app) but then bounces to /login. Likely the /app onboarding/household gate redirects a fresh free user back to /login. Session was created (toast proves it), so this is a routing/gate issue for free-tier accounts rather than an auth failure. Recommend treating access_state='free' as a legitimate state on /app and routing the free user to the onboarding/dashboard without logging them out.

action_items: (LOW) Move FreeAllowanceBadge JSX in AnonymousInvoiceCheck.jsx above the anon-run-btn block so D2 copy is seen BEFORE the run commits.

(MEDIUM) In /app/frontend/src/pages/resources/Articles.jsx line 585, drop the `secs.length >= 3` guard (or clamp to 0) so every structured SEO article still gets the ~60% inline offer. Verified failure on /resources/articles/switching-support-at-home-provider-practical-playbook.
(MEDIUM) Investigate why a fresh free account lands on /login after /app — likely the /app household/onboarding gate doesn't accept access_state='free'. Should route to the free dashboard instead.
critical_code_review_comments: _compute_access_state (server.py:3810) is the single source of truth and correctly routes paid-lapsed → view_only via has_paid_ever, never-paid lapsed → free. Good separation.
The _enforce_read_only_for_unpaid middleware (server.py:8939) cleanly branches on state=='free' vs 'view_only' and exempts /api/invoices/upload for free writes; this is the right place for D gating.

check_free_tool_usage per-tool limits are expressed as _tool_limits={'PROVIDER_PRICE_CHECKER': 2}; limit field is included in the response, so FreeAllowanceBadge renders the right text without a second config.
ArticleOfferBlock.OFFER_BY_CATEGORY covers all required categories; resolveOffer splits billing by statement vs invoice correctly.
conv1.js dry-run path is console.debug-only in preview — no GA4 leakage.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (two minor UI defects: inline offer gated on >=3 sections; allowance badge positioned after run button)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_conv1_v2_free_tier_iter421.py is a reusable regression suite (12 tests: access_state matrix, 402 free/view_only branching on /api/support/tickets, free GET not 402, trial can write, free user blocked from paid tool, per-tool allowance limits, usage schema). It auto-loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. The topic→offer matrix verified on web: complaints→ask_wayly, CHSP→free_account, AT-HM→free_account, fees→contribution_estimator, statement SEO→statement_decoder, switching (end)→price_checker. Structured articles with <3 sections currently LOSE the inline offer — regression test this after fix.
rca of the issue: G1 inline-offer defect RCA: In /app/frontend/src/pages/resources/Articles.jsx the structured renderer computes `const offerAfter = secs.length >= 3 ? Math.ceil(secs.length * 0.6) - 1 : -1;`. For a structured article with 1 or 2 sections (e.g. the 'switching-support-at-home-provider-practical-playbook' playbook) offerAfter is forced to -1, so the inline <ArticleOfferBlock variant='inline'/> injected by `idx === offerAfter` never mounts. The end offer still mounts unconditionally at line 664, which is why we saw end=price_checker but inline=None on that article. Fix: either `Math.max(0, Math.ceil(secs.length * 0.6) - 1)` (always inject) or move the inline block out of the sections loop and render it unconditionally (e.g. before the StepFlow) the way the prose renderer at line 400 does.
